shortDescription: NSE is set to mark a long-awaited listing, with MD and CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan reflecting on his journey and the exchange’s next phase. With 13 crore unique investors and 27 crore accounts, Chauhan points to the significant growth potential in India’s capital markets.

title: NSE Listing: Ashish Kumar Chauhan on ringing the bell for the fifth time
